title: Solar system
why: Tests whether the model holds a set of real facts (relative orbital periods and sizes) while writing an animation, rather than picking one or the other.
prompt: Write a single self-contained HTML file that animates the solar system: the Sun and the eight planets orbiting it. Keep the relative orbital periods roughly correct so the inner planets visibly move faster, label each planet, and let the user hover a planet to see its name. Use only HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with a canvas. Output only the file contents.
